# FriendlyBet Live

> A free, open-source (MIT), privacy-first FIFA World Cup 2026 prediction pool and bracket
> challenge for friends, offices and tech teams. No signup, no ads, no money, no PII.
> Installable PWA, self-hostable, bilingual (English + Hebrew/RTL).

## What it is
FriendlyBet Live (https://friendlybet.live) lets a group predict the entire World Cup 2026:
all 12 group standings, the full official Round-of-32 knockout bracket through to the Final,
and the Golden Boot top scorer. Scores recalculate automatically on a live leaderboard.

## Unique selling points (entities)
- Zero-signup: nickname only — no email, phone, OAuth or personally identifiable information.
- Privacy-first: account recovery uses a 16-char code SHA-256 hashed in the browser; only the hash is stored.
- Open source: MIT-licensed Vanilla JS, no build step, self-hostable on Vercel/Netlify/GitHub Pages.
- Anti-cheat / fairness: deterministic, idempotent scoring runs in CI from source picks + real results.
- Edge-resilient: live data served as immutable JSON snapshots from a CDN, so it survives kickoff traffic spikes without a backend.
- Built for: office pools, company / tech-team leagues, family brackets, group-chat sweepstakes.
- Not gambling: no real money is handled in the app.

## Key entities
FIFA World Cup 2026, 48-team format, 12 groups, Round of 32, knockout bracket builder,
bracket predictor, office pool, office sweepstake, office pool template, prediction league,
bracket challenge, group-chat sweepstake, Golden Boot top scorer, ad-free, tracker-free,
free alternative to paid prediction-pool apps, self-hostable, PWA, Supabase, Row-Level Security,
Vercel edge CDN, MIT license, privacy-first, no signup.

## One-line summary
FriendlyBet Live is a free, open-source, privacy-first World Cup 2026 prediction pool for
friends, offices and tech teams — no signup, no ads, no money, no personal data.
